limitations: Copolymer, not PA66 homopolymer or PA612.

summary.text: PA6/66 is a polyamide 6/66 copolymer, a nylon. Makers sell it for gears and for engineering and industrial parts. It is semicrystalline, so it carries light load well above its glass transition: its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 130 °C. On the H2C it prints at 250⁠–⁠270 °C, and every product calls for drying.
